requirements.name: DATABASE_PATH
requirements.description: Where the server keeps each potter's copy of their pots (a SQLite file, with photos in a folder beside it). Lives on the application's own disk, which survives restarts and deploys.

datastore.capacity_basis: A few friends, each saving up to a few hundred pots with one or two photos of about 300 KB each, which comes to well under 1 GB a year.
